deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace, Multiverse Architect leads a four-color planeswalker deck supported by Reality Fracture's reimagined legends, theoretical themes, and Jace-associated cards. Develop your mana, build a board around your planeswalkers, and use draw and removal to sustain a longer game. The finishing package offers several routes to victory, chief among them Jace, Reality Sculptor, with substantial creature threats as backup. The deck gives up streamlined aggression and combo speed for thematic variety, and its four-color mana base needs careful sequencing. For three priority buy-list suggestions, start with Jace, Reality Sculptor, The Theorist, Jace Beleren, and Way of the Mind Sculptor.

The quality model grades this deck below the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
